# UnpauseAI

> EU-based automation consultancy. Production-grade workflow automation for regulated industries and scaling operations. GDPR-aware by design. Based in Karlsruhe, Germany. Founder: Nicolas Neumann.

UnpauseAI builds and ships custom workflow automation: lead and inquiry automation, CRM and ERP integration, sales campaign operations, custom data pipelines, Make.com to n8n migration, and GDPR-compliant automation for regulated industries. Engagements are fixed-fee and scoped up front, typically delivered in three to seven weeks, with documentation and monitoring handed over at the end.

UnpauseAI is an automation consultancy. It is a separate entity from PauseAI, the AI-safety advocacy organization; the names are similar but the two are unrelated.
